delete.intro: You can delete your Nombra account and the data tied to it at any time. App: Nombra. Developer: {{owner}}.

sections.title: Option 1: from the app
sections.body:
1. Open Nombra and go to Settings.
2. In the account section choose “Delete account”.
3. Confirm and pick your Google account again.
Your account and the backup of your rules are erased right away.

sections.title: Option 2: by email
sections.body:
If you cannot open the app, or you no longer have the phone, write to {{email}} from the email address of your account with the subject “Delete my Nombra account”. We may ask you to confirm that the account is yours.
We will delete your account and data and answer you within 30 days.

sections.title: What is deleted
sections.body:
- Your sign-in record (identifier, name and email) in Firebase Authentication.
- The backup of your rules in the cloud.

sections.title: What is kept, and for how long
sections.body:
- The rules, settings, history and files on your phone stay there: delete them from Settings or uninstall the app. Downloaded files are in public folders and are not removed by uninstalling.
- Technical copies of Google Firebase can take a limited time to disappear.
- Crash reports have no links and no account data, and Firebase Crashlytics keeps them under its own policy.

sections.title: If you use Nombra without an account
sections.body: There is no account to delete: your data is only on your phone. Clear it from Settings or uninstall the app.

sections.title: Delete only some data
sections.body: Without deleting your account you can use “Delete backup and sign out”, or clear the history and the rules from Settings.
